head: 151462ea3a2002eda225c426dd3572c188237a2c
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer for the F19 delivery session)
scope: The F19 diff against f16-dispatch-brief at 151462ea3 and the design change c243266f0, and the tree merged with f16-dispatch-brief at a187463ce. Probed nested and deferred directives in copies, a section included and composed, dispatches and briefed dispatches in copies routed apart, briefs composing sections, picks and sets, W_SUBST_UNUSED cases and subfolder documents. Excluded observations: (1) a deferred directive naming an ambiguous fragment fails with E_UNEXPECTED_INTERNAL_ERROR; scope evidence: f16-dispatch-brief at d252f2233 fails alike; arising issue https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/795. (2) Two directives whose presets map one key apart were refused with E_INVALID_USAGE; scope evidence: the Proposal kept the union refusal, and the user's later decision is applied in round three.
criteria: AC1 and AC2: the two fixtures pass in make corpus. AC3: make check passes at 151462ea3. Findings 1 and 2 broke the Proposal's rule once merged with the moved base.
validation: pytest without the bootstrap test, corpus 667 of 667, ruff and mypy at 151462ea3; the tree merged with a187463ce passed pytest and corpus 669 of 669.

findings.description: Merged with f16-dispatch-brief's loop walk, a brief was walked under the group's union, so a brief only the tagged copy routes into a loop was refused with E_DISPATCH_CYCLE.
A copy picking no alternative escaped E_ALTERNATIVE_UNRESOLVED when another copy picked one, since alternatives were counted on the union alone.
A briefed dispatch two copies route apart was refused with E_HEADING_COLLISION under a remedy an author could not follow, and no document stated the refusal.
invocation.md, the governing and picked docstrings, docs/selection.md and the glossary still described union routing for every copy.
The copy rule was restated in the Substitution docstring rather than named by its owner.
Two sentences, in docs/dispatch.md and the Placing docstring, read ambiguously.
A default pair in force for a copy alone that no reference used raised no W_SUBST_UNUSED.

scope: The merge 2cff2e21b of f16-dispatch-brief at 4cbd9db52, the user's two decisions in 40d0d51c6 and c4098f7ef (a group governed by its including references, alternatives counted per copy), and the design change 61c8250f7. Excluded observation: a directive naming an ambiguous fragment and two alternatives reports E_ALTERNATIVE_UNRESOLVED before E_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE_HEADING; scope evidence: the pick was checked in traversal before selection on f16-dispatch-brief too; arising issue https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/796.

findings.description: A copy's alternative route warned W_SUBST_USED where the group's ordinary preset stated a stand-in for the same key, since quiet routes were keyed on document and key alone.
invocation.md still said conflicting substitutes for one document's key fail, which two copies no longer do.
The W_SUBST_UNUSED message for a copy's pair said no reference the run resolved, though the run resolved it elsewhere.
A copy was refused for want of an alternative whose only effect is a group pair, which places no copy.
The composition module docstring restated rules governing and resolved own.

head: e19511f0147297fd50b20bb8d108209bc1502382
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (fresh independent reviewer for the F19 delivery session)
scope: The merge e19511f01 of main at d4e3695e1, carrying F16 and F20 (#797), into F19, and the full diff d4e3695e1..e19511f01. Checked F20's fragment-first ordering, its --pick remedy and the pick token kept in entry tags under per-copy counting; probed entries with ? and --pick beside copies, ambiguous composed and brief fragments with two picks, deferred directives with ?, copies picking apart, group-pair alternatives, nested copies, stubs, dispatch placement and stand-in warnings. Excluded observations, each pre-existing on main at d4e3695e1: (1) a default pair agreeing with a picked alternative leaves its redirect silent; arising issue https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/800. (2) A picking dispatch whose brief an alternative routes is refused under a remedy naming titles, which defeats the pick; arising issue https://github.com/m2ux/prosiform/issues/801.
criteria: AC1, AC2, AC4 and AC5 fixtures pass; AC3 by make check. Finding 1 regressed a warning main gives.
validation: pytest without the bootstrap test, corpus 680 of 680, ruff and mypy at e19511f01; make check exits 0 there (2270 tests, harness 1119, corpus 680 of 680).

findings.description: copies let the last preset stating a key win, so a copy selecting an ordinary preset declared before an agreeing alternative lost the stand-in W_SUBST_USED warning main gives.
A copy's E_ALTERNATIVE_UNRESOLVED named only the document, and its remedy pointed at the titles of every link reaching it, the entry's among them.
The composition module docstring owned the per-copy pair rule that copies applies.
The composition module docstring named governing and resolved, internals of another module.
